source: V20 Disciplines (pp. 130-243): the V20 powers the Dark Ages library does not already hold by name

powers.e: Talk with a beast while holding its gaze; orders need the roll (6 predatory mammals, 7 other mammals and birds of prey, 8 other birds and reptiles; 1 easier in its own voice). Insects and fish are too simple.
Call one kind of animal within earshot: 1 success brings one, 2 a quarter, 3 half, 4 most, 5 all; they come well disposed but uncontrolled.
Extended, to the subject's Willpower in successes, by touch or gaze: the mortal's strong feelings drain away; they cannot use or regain Willpower and stay listless.

Push the vampire's own frenzy into someone in sight: 1 success a random target, 2 the chosen one but the vampire loses a turn (or a Willpower or a lethal level), 3 or more cleanly. The vampire stays calm.

Read a subject's aura after a few seconds' look: 1 success the shade, 2 the main colour, 3 the pattern, 4 shifts, 5 mixtures; shows mood and whether they are a vampire, ghoul, mage, shapeshifter or diablerist.
Send thoughts (one success) or read them, a success for each fact or layer; the subject feels the intrusion but cannot place it without Perception + Awareness. Kindred need a Willpower point to read.
Leave the body as a silver-corded astral form, flying anywhere under the moon (5 in sight, 7 familiar, 9 far); the body lies torpid. A cut cord strands the mind.
A still illusion that touches every sense (a cellar as a ballroom); it lasts until dispelled, but has no substance.
A blood point gives an illusion motion (a lurking mugger, a flickering lamp); doing anything that needs a roll first needs a Willpower roll or the illusion fails.
Heighten or dull a feeling the victim already has, shifting frenzy, Virtue or resist rolls by 1 or 2: 1 success a turn, 2 an hour, 3 a night, 4 a week, 5 a month, 6 three months.
Fill a victim's senses with things that are not there, dice pools down briefly after a bad one: 1 success a night, 2 two nights, 3 a week, 4 a month, 5 three months, 6 a year.
One listener a success falls into frenzy or terror for the scene; Kindred and shapeshifters resist with a frenzy or fear check 2 harder, mortals cannot and forget it. The vampire may be caught too.
After a full turn of attention, five derangements: 1 success a turn, 2 a night, 3 a week, 4 a month, 5 a year.
See and hear ghosts in the living world for the scene; on a botch the vampire sees only the dead (+3 to sight rolls).
Talk with ghosts freely across the Shroud.
Touch the ghostly world: ghosts and their things are solid to the vampire for the scene (a blood point each further scene), and ghosts can touch back.
Make a corpse move once, from a twitch to a set trigger at 5 successes; never an attack.
Raise a corpse a success to do one simple, literal task until done or destroyed.
Contested Willpower: a living soul is pushed out of its body for an hour a success, the body left catatonic. Not on the supernatural, ghouls aside.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: Take a corpse's look, or force it on another vampire: Dexterity and Appearance -2, Intimidation +2 dice; still, it passes for a corpse unless Perception + Medicine (7) gets 5 successes.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: No wound penalties for the scene, a die more to resist emotional sway and a die less to sway others.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: A target within 20 yards suffers the needs of the living (+2 to all rolls, a Willpower a scene to ignore) and cannot eat or rise easily.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: A turn a success as a mere corpse: holy things and frenzy do nothing, sunlight does only bashing, a stake is a flesh wound and fire does lethal.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Corpse in the Monster
powers.e: Burn twelve blood: for a day the vampire eats, breathes, warms and walks in the sun as the living do; a botch can kill or Embrace.
Vitae dripped on a corpse turns it to dust in five turns less the successes.
Touch a limb (Dexterity + Brawl if resisted): two aggravated levels, and unless both are soaked the limb is useless until they heal.
A target within 20 yards resists with Stamina (+ Fortitude) at the caster's Willpower or takes a sickness: Strength and Wits halved, Dexterity -1, an extra blood each night.
Vitae poured on a vampire: Willpower at their Stamina + 3, an aggravated level a success as the flesh turns to ash.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Four Humours
powers.e: Drink and spend five blood from a cold corpse: for the scene two more soak dice usable against aggravated, and the power of the dead behind the vampire.

powers.d: Necromancy: the Path of the Four Humours
powers.e: Breathe a black cloud five yards across a success: those inside who cannot escape need more Willpower successes (8 mortals, 7 others) or sink into despair, mortals toward suicide.
See death's marks on someone: injury, sickness or a curse; 1 success when they will die within weeks, 3 how, 5 the exact night.
Draw one to four points of death energy from a place of recent death, or from a ghost, to spend as blood on Necromancy.
A fog of death energy: a quarter mile around (more with blood) it draws Spectres, or aimed at one living target it brings disease.
Unseen while still and quiet in a shadowed spot; only higher Auspex sees through.

Living darkness 10 feet across, doubling a success, within 50 yards (out of sight 2 harder and a blood): it smothers light and sound, chills, and those inside without Obtenebration take +2 and may panic.
A six-foot tentacle a success from the shadows, Strength and Dexterity equal to Obtenebration (plus Potence and Celerity), four health levels, grappling and crushing.
Become part shadow: four tentacles, touch that chills (Stamina 7 or -2 dice), and Intimidation a die easier. A botch does two unsoakable lethal levels.
Become a living shadow, immune to physical harm (not fire or sun), seeping through cracks and smothering others as Shroud of Night; mental Disciplines still work.
Claws for the scene: Strength + 1 aggravated, hard to soak; climbing 2 easier.
Become mist in three turns (a blood a turn faster): immune to mundane harm, a level less from fire and sun, floating through any gap; no eye-contact powers.
Twenty feet of total silence around the vampire for an hour.
A golden hypnotic gaze: a mortal who meets it cannot move until it breaks; the supernatural only on a Willpower roll (9), and may spend Willpower if hurt.
An 18-inch forked tongue: Strength aggravated, and after a wound the vampire drinks as with fangs; darkness penalties halved.
Scaly skin: soak at 5, Stamina soaks claws and fangs, bite a die stronger, fits through any gap the head passes; Appearance 1.
Become a great black cobra in three turns until dawn: a poisonous bite (deadly to mortals) without grappling; hearing 2 harder.
Take out the vampire's own heart (on the night of a new moon) to hide it: no staking, and frenzy is 2 easier to resist; whoever holds it holds the vampire.
Touch a vampire: each success makes them spend a blood as the thaumaturge chooses and raises their frenzy difficulty by 1.
Successes split between lowering the thaumaturge's Generation a step and an hour each.
Three dots split between Strength and Stamina, a turn a success (Willpower adds one).
Talk with a plant's spirit by touch: 1 success impressions, 3 a simple answer, 5 all it knows.
Grow or wither a touched plant: 3 successes visibly, 5 from seed to tree or to dust in minutes; 3 ruin a wooden weapon.
Animate plants up to the thaumaturge's mass, a turn a success; in a fight Strength and Dexterity half the Willpower.
A shelter of plants in three turns until sunset; entering uninvited takes more successes on Wits + Survival at the caster's Willpower; 4 successes shut out the sun.
A touched tree walks and fights for a turn a success (a blood each): Strength and Stamina the Thaumaturgy rating, Dexterity 2.
A touched lifeless thing ages ten years a minute.
Warp fifty pounds of wood in sight a blood (stakes, bows, doors).
Acid from the skin: a blood eats a quarter inch of steel or three of wood, and close attacks do aggravated for a blood a turn.
A limb withers: Stamina + Athletics (8) needs three successes to resist; one is +2 to use it, two +1. Vampires regrow it for five blood.
A touch ages a mortal ten years a success unless Stamina + Courage (8) gets more; Kindred only pale for a night.
Conjure fire, placed more surely with more successes (about 10 yards a success, anywhere in sight at 5): a candle in the hand at level 1, hotter at higher levels; it burns as fire does.
Look into still water and see what it saw: a day back with 1 success, a week 2, a month 3, a year 4, ten years 5.
Water seizes a subject: they need as many successes on Strength (8) to break free.
A touch turns a blood point a success to water: one kills a mortal in minutes; vampires take penalties as if wounded.
Three Willpower more: a wall of water 10 feet a success in each direction until sunrise that the supernatural cannot pass without Willpower successes beyond the caster's.
Draw the water from someone in sight: Stamina + Fortitude (9) resists, each net success a lethal level (vampires lose blood instead); they may be stunned.
Make a simple one-material object (a pipe, a stake); a Willpower each turn keeps it.
Three blood make a conjured simple object real for good.
Five blood make a complex, working object (a gun, a phone); hard ones need a Knowledge roll too.
Extended: as many successes as its maker had unmake a conjured object.
Ten blood make a mindless simulacrum of a creature or person that obeys simple orders and fades within a week.
Someone in sight does the opposite of what they meant; Perception + Subterfuge at the successes + 2 notices or resists.
With eye contact, a hidden shameful urge takes over: 1 success five minutes, 2 an hour, 3 a night, 4 three nights, 5 a week.
A touch, Willpower resists: -3 dice to all Social rolls for five minutes to a week by successes; it can break a blood bond's pull for that time.
Make a touched subject crave something they are exposed to (Self-Control at successes + 3 resists): a fix every night or -1 die a night.
A conversation bonds the subject's psyche to the thaumaturge a night a success: -1 die away from them, and Willpower against them is harder.
Courage +1 and Willpower counts 1 higher against hostile powers for the scene.
One close attack hits without a roll, as a single success.
Dodge every attack this scene with the full pool.
Strength, Dexterity and Stamina +1 for the scene; afterwards two hours' rest or lose a blood every quarter hour.
Give a lower power of the path to a touched packmate too, one roll each.
Touch a device and understand it: 1 success the basics, 3 competence, 5 everything, for Intelligence minutes.
Surge a device within Willpower x 10 yards: 1 success a turn's glitch, 2 +1 to use it, 3 broken, 4 lasting harm, 5 ruined.
Control a device in sight without touching it, a turn a success, using no more Ability dots than the successes.
Send the mind into the net through a connected device, five minutes a success; range 25 miles with 1 success up to worldwide with 5.
Reveal the subject's blood bonds and Vinculi, with names and impressions of the vampires.
Appearance 0 for a night; Social rolls fail except to intimidate.
The victim cannot keep blood down and must eat ashes, which only let them rise each night.
For a week light pains the victim, and bright light does an aggravated level a turn.
Three turns of verse return a diablerist to their original Generation for a week.
Rain or snow over the area: Perception rolls +2 and Drive +2.
Winds of 30 mph gusting double: firearms +1, thrown and bows +2, Dexterity to keep standing.
A bolt on a target in sight: 10 lethal dice, armour does not help soak.
Grapple someone and reshape their flesh (5 crude to 9 precise): Appearance up or down a point a success, or other grotesque work.
Reshape bone: as a weapon, a lethal level a success as bones tear out; or spikes and talons on the vampire.
An eight-foot horror: Physical Attributes +3, Social 0 (Strength for intimidation), brawling damage +1.
Turn parts of the body (or all of it) to living vitae, two blood a leg or the torso, one an arm, the head or the belly; whole, the vampire cannot be staked or cut.
